user.description: Adds a battery sensor to each beacon device that sends a battery frame. All settings have defaults. Change them later under Configure.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Beacon Battery is already set up.

data_description.source_domain: Integration whose devices get a battery sensor. Only devices it identifies by MAC address are used.
data_description.frames: Service data frames that carry battery %, one per line, as uuid:byte or uuid:byte:prefix. byte is the position of the level, counting from 0. prefix (hex) must start the data, which tells apart frames that share a UUID. The frame that changed last is read. When several change at once, the lowest level wins, then list order.
data_description.max_level: Higher readings are capped to this value.
data_description.heartbeat_minutes: Every this many minutes, the level of each beacon still in range is written again, so battery checks see it as alive.

error.invalid_frame: Write each frame as uuid:byte or uuid:byte:prefix, for example 2080:0 or feaa:2:22. The UUID is 16-bit (2080) or full 128-bit; the prefix is hex.
